#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll mpow(ll a, ll e) {
    ll r = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) {
            r = (r * a) % MOD;
        }
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << mpow(p, p - 1) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << mpow(p, p) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    ll order = 1;
    ll cur = k;
    while (cur != 1) {
        cur = (cur * k) % p;
        order++;
    }
    cout << mpow(p, (p - 1) / order) << '\n';
    return 0;
}

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll binpow(ll x, ll n) {
    ll ans = 1;
    while (n > 0) {
        if (n % 2 == 1) ans = (ans * x) % MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
        n /= 2;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {

    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << binpow(p, p - 1) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << binpow(p, p) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    ll order = 1;

    do {
        cur = (cur * k) % p;
        ++order;

    cout << binpow(p, (p - 1) / order) << "\n";

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll fpow(ll b, ll e) {
    ll result = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1LL) {
            result *= b;
            result %= MOD;
        }
        b *= b;
        b %= MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

ll multiplicative_order(ll p, ll k) {
    ll cnt = 1;
    ll now = k;
    for (;;) {
        if (now == 1) break;
        now = (now * k) % p;
        ++cnt;
    }
    return cnt;
}

int main() {
    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fpow(p, p - 1) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << fpow(p, p) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    ll ord = multiplicative_order(p, k);
    cout << fpow(p, (p - 1) / ord) << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll power_mod(ll base, ll exponent) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (exponent > 0) {
        if (exponent & 1) res = res * base % MOD;
        base = base * base % MOD;
        exponent >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ll p, k;
    scanf("%lld %lld", &p, &k);

    if (k == 0) {
        printf("%lld\n", power_mod(p, p - 1));
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        printf("%lld\n", power_mod(p, p));
        return 0;
    }

    ll order = 1;
    for (ll cur = k; cur != 1; ++order) {
        cur = (cur * k) % p;
    }

    printf("%lld\n", power_mod(p, (p - 1) / order));
    return 0;
}
